blocks.text: Browser-based coding platform with AI pair programming

Replit puts a complete development environment in your browser. No installation, no configuration, no DevOps - just start coding and deploy. For developers, it removes the friction of local setup. For non-developers, it provides a guided path into building software with AI assistance.

Replit Agent, the AI coding assistant, can build entire applications from natural language descriptions. It sets up the project structure, writes the code, installs dependencies, and handles deployment. You can intervene and modify at any point, making it a true collaboration between human intent and AI execution.

The collaboration features make Replit valuable for teams and education. Multiple people can code in the same project simultaneously, share running applications instantly, and review changes in real-time - like Google Docs for software development.
Full development environment - terminal, editor, preview - in the browser
Build applications from natural language with AI pair programming
One-click deploy with included hosting and custom domains
Support for Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Go, Rust, and more
Multiple users coding in the same project simultaneously
Pre-configured project templates for common frameworks and use cases

Replit eliminates the gap between writing code and deploying it. For prototyping, hackathons, and situations where you need a working application fast, there is nothing quicker than going from idea to deployed app in a single browser tab.
Our team can integrate Replit into your workflow and automate the repetitive parts.
